title: Variational quantum eigensolver with reduced circuit complexity
problem_summary: Introduces ClusterVQE: splits the qubit space into entanglement-informed clusters distributed across shallower individual circuits, with inter-cluster entanglement captured via a 'dressed' effective Hamiltonian, trading additional classical resources for reduced circuit depth/qubit count per subcircuit.

components.family_or_name: ClusterVQE: mutual-information-based qubit clustering into shallower sub-circuits
components.notes: Clusters chosen based on quantum mutual information reflecting maximal intra-cluster entanglement.

workflow_composition_notes: Preprocessing step (clustering + dressed Hamiltonian construction) applied before a standard VQE loop runs on each shallower sub-circuit; trades classical preprocessing cost for reduced quantum circuit complexity.
